Can be only used while its hammer has been taken out. }} {{QuoteContainer| |-|Current = {{QuoteBox|A boss is approaching!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 31 ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]])}} |-|Translated = {{QuoteBox|The miracle happened!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 31 ([[Translated#Dialogue|Translated Hardcore]])}} |-|April Fools 2022 = {{QuoteBox|A boss is appwoaching! ε=ε=(っ*´□`)っ|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 31 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Hardcore]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fallen Titan''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. For its debut, it had a high amount of health, presenting a major challenge. It also had [[Shield Health]], meaning that you did not earn any money from the initial 1,000 health. Initially, it spawns with its hammer on its back. However, at some point, it will stop to wield its hammer. While this reduces its speed, it can now use its hammer to stun towers and damage units. A shield also appears when it takes out its hammer, however it is only visual. Additionally, it has [[Stun Immunity]], meaning that it cannot be completely stopped by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] and it cannot be knocked back. ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Titan''' has reflective black skin and a neon purple faceless face. It wears a dark purple granite galea helmet, with horns sticking out the side of it. It also wears a dark purple chestplate, knee-pads and shoulder-pads, which are spiky. Its torso and legs are dark purple too. It wears black boots and gloves. Its head is slightly tilted sideways. On its back is a deep granite sharp hammer with spikes on it. This can be held by the '''Fallen Titan''' after its ''Hammer'' ability. Purple particles are emitted from its boots, torso and hammer. ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Fallen Titan''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *Due to its high health, high DPS towers are recommended against this, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]], [[Turret]] and [[Ranger]]. *While it may seem like the damage is capped at 40 due to its shield, this shield is only visual. For example, a tower like the [[Ranger]] can deal full damage to it, even if the damage is over 40. *The [[Engineer]] can be very useful against this enemy, as the [[Engineer]]'s sentries can continue attacking the '''Fallen Titan''' even when the [[Engineer]] is stunned. **While the '''Fallen Titan''' can damage its units, the damage dealt is low and can only destroy [[Sentry (Unit)|Sentry]] and [[Rifle Sentry]] (without shield) in one hit, while others will survive. ***You can also use the [[Medic]] to make the [[Engineer]] itself immune to stuns, making the sentries practically invulnerable to the stuns. *Make sure to defeat the '''Fallen Titan''' as fast as possible. If you can, try to kill it before it can equip its hammer. **You may want to set your towers' targeting to ''Strongest'' to ensure this. *It is not possible to use the [[Medic]] to prevent its stuns, as when hit by the shockwave, the shield will disappear and the tower will end up getting stunned. *Towers like [[Freezer]], [[Sledger]], [[Warden]] and [[Frost Blaster]] will only slow down the '''Fallen Titan''' for a short amount of time due to its large size. **The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Toxic Gunner]] are unaffected by its size. **It also has [[Stun Immunity]], which prevents stunning towers like the [[Warden]] from stunning it, slowing it down instead and makes knockback towers like the [[Brawler]] not knock it back. *As the '''Fallen Titan''' takes out its hammer when there are towers nearby, reducing its speed, it may be beneficial to place down few cheap towers next to the path to slow it down. **As it can stun towers with its hammer, it is recommended to put such towers very close to the path away from where most towers are placed to prevent the '''Fallen Titan''' from stunning them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} the original [[Frost Hero (Pre-MEGA)|Frost Hero]] in terms of abilities. **In terms of appearance, it is similar to the legacy [[Molten Titan (Legacy)|Molten Titan]] and the legacy [[Fallen Soul (Legacy)|Fallen Soul]]. *The '''Fallen Titan''' is the first enemy to have two death animations. **The first only occurs when its ''Hammer'' ability has not been used. It will fall with the hammer on its back. **The second only occurs when its ''Hammer'' ability has been used. It will fall with the hammer on the side. *The horns on the '''Fallen Titan''' are a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|215718515|Fiery Horns Of The Netherworld}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The helmet worn by the '''Fallen Titan''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|335080498|Winged Helm of the Redcliff Elite}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The shoulder guards worn by the '''Fallen Titan''' are a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|3267573976|Crushing Crystals Pauldrons}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The hammer used by the '''Fallen Titan''' is an altered version of the [[w:c:r2da:Ice_Sledge|Ice Sledge]] from ''Reason 2 Die: Awakening.'' *The '''Fallen Titan''' will always use its ''Hammer'' ability a few seconds after spawning. If there are no towers nearby, it will put the hammer back on its back. *The [[Shield]] that the '''Fallen Titan''' has is purely visual. The damage dealt to it can be higher than 40 even when the [[Shield]] is active. **This results in the '''Fallen Titan''' being the only enemy currently with [[Shield]], albeit the latter not functioning as intended. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Fallen Titan''' added. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Fallen Titan''' freezes towers instead of stunning them. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Fallen Titan''' no longer freezes towers. *'''12 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]] **{{Bug}} Gains a visual [[Shield]] of 40. **{{Bug}} ''Smash'' ability hitbox size is significantly larger than it should be. **{{Bug}} '''Fallen Titan''' freezes towers instead of stunning them. *'''16 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]]d **{{Bugfix}} ''Smash'' ability hitbox size is no longer significantly larger than it should be. *'''23 May 2023''' - [[v1.7.3]]a **[[Energy Immunity]] replaced with [[Stun Immunity]]. *'''10 May 2024''' - [[v1.21.0]] **{{Bug}} ''Smash'' ability no longer has a visible shockwave. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **{{Bug}} The visibly shockwave area and the actual stun area are not the same. **{{Bugfix}} ''Smash'' ability now has a visible shockwave. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Fallen Titan''' removed from the main game, as it has been replaced by [[Void Titan]].
